name: Postmark
summary: Postmark is a transactional email service that sends through an HTTP API. Paid plans start at $15 a month for 10,000 emails, and the free plan covers 100 emails a month. Message history is kept 45 days by default, and the Pro and Platform plans can extend it to 365 days.

facts.text: The outbound message search returns up to 10,000 messages per search, and each message record lists events such as delivered, bounced, opened and link clicked.
Message retention defaults to 45 days and can be set between 7 and 365 days.
The bounce API documents 23 bounce types, including HardBounce, SoftBounce and SpamComplaint, and each bounce record shows whether Postmark deactivated the address.
Postmark's pricing page lists no plan between the free 100 emails a month and the 10,000 email paid tier.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: 100 emails a month, no overages allowed

plans.name: Basic
plans.notes: Extra emails cost $1.80 per 1,000. 45 days of message history

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: Extra emails cost $1.30 per 1,000. History can be extended up to 365 days

plans.name: Platform
plans.notes: Extra emails cost $1.20 per 1,000. History can be extended up to 365 days

hiddenCosts: Dedicated IPs start at $50 a month per IP, need Pro or higher, and are offered to senders at 300,000 or more emails a month.
Custom activity retention starts at $5 a month.
DMARC monitoring starts at $14 a month per domain.
Unused emails do not roll over to the next month.

contract.cancellation: Cancellation is made in the service and takes effect at the end of the current billing period. Plans renew until the user cancels.
contract.dataExport: The terms say all data related to the account is lost on cancellation.
